features.name: Production order statuses
features.description: Production orders progress through multiple statuses representing commitment levels: simulated as a safe sandbox, planned as production suggestions, firm planned after approval, released for shop floor execution, and finished to close work for cost analysis.

features.name: Production order creation from master data
features.description: When a production order is refreshed, Business Central uses production BOM to define component demand, routing to define operations, and calendar and capacity setup to define scheduled start and finish times, combining material, time, and cost expectations.

features.name: Components function
features.description: Allows viewing which components a production order needs and the quantity of each required component.

features.name: Routing function
features.description: Shows scheduled operations with start and finish date-time, operational times, and routing link code for each operation in the production order.

features.name: Statistics function
features.description: Displays expected costs and capacity needs for a production order during the planning phase before release to production.

features.name: Item availability by BOM level
features.description: Once a production order is firm planned, this feature shows whether enough units are available to produce the required order, identifies which component creates the bottleneck, and displays for each component how many are needed, how many are available, and how many parent items can be produced.

features.name: Production journal
features.description: A document that combines components from the production BOM and routings for released production orders. It lists items to be consumed during production, shows where each component is consumed based on routing links, and allows operators to adjust consumption quantities and operational times before posting.

features.name: Production journal posting
features.description: When an operator posts the production journal after reviewing and adjusting consumption quantities and operational times, it effectively consumes components, accounts for capacity usage, and turns floor activity into accurate inventory, capacity, and cost postings.

features.name: Routing link code
features.description: A mechanism in production BOM that shows where each component is consumed during production, linking components to specific operations.
